building  id UUID PRIMARY KEY code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL address TEXT NOT NULL

apartment  id UUID PRIMARY KEY building_id UUID NOT NULL code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL floor_no INTEGER NOT NULL area_m2 NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (area_m2 >= 0) status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('VACANT','OCCUPIED','INACTIVE')) UNIQUE(building_id, code) CHECK(area_m2 > 0) FK building_id → building.id
household  id UUID PRIMARY KEY code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL closed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

household_apartment  id UUID PRIMARY KEY household_id UUID NOT NULL apartment_id UUID NOT NULL valid_from DATE NOT NULL valid_to DATE CHECK(valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from) FK household_id → household.id FK apartment_id → apartment.id

resident  id UUID PRIMARY KEY full_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL identity_no VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE birth_date DATE NOT NULL gender VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (gender IN ('MALE','FEMALE','OTHER','UNSPECIFIED')) phone VARCHAR(20)

household_member  id UUID PRIMARY KEY household_id UUID NOT NULL resident_id UUID NOT NULL relationship VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL is_head BOOLEAN NOT NULL valid_from DATE NOT NULL valid_to DATE CHECK(valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from) FK household_id → household.id FK resident_id → resident.id

residence_change  id UUID PRIMARY KEY household_id UUID NOT NULL resident_id UUID target_household_id UUID requested_by UUID NOT NULL approved_by UUID change_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (change_type IN ('MOVE_IN','MOVE_OUT','TRANSFER','TEMPORARY_ABSENCE','TEMPORARY_RESIDENCE')) effective_from DATE NOT NULL effective_to DATE status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','CANCELLED')) details TEXT NOT NULL FK household_id → household.id FK resident_id → resident.id FK target_household_id → household.id FK requested_by → app_user.id FK approved_by → app_user.id

vehicle  id UUID PRIMARY KEY household_id UUID NOT NULL plate_no VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL vehicle_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (vehicle_type IN ('MOTORBIKE','CAR','BICYCLE','OTHER')) registered_from DATE NOT NULL registered_to DATE FK household_id → household.id

fee_type  id UUID PRIMARY KEY code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL basis VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ('PER_APARTMENT','PER_M2','PER_PERSON','PER_VEHICLE','ACTUAL')) mandatory BOOLEAN NOT NULL active BOOLEAN NOT NULL

fee_rate  id UUID PRIMARY KEY fee_type_id UUID NOT NULL vehicle_type VARCHAR(20) CHECK (vehicle_type IN ('MOTORBIKE','CAR','BICYCLE','OTHER')) unit_price NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0) effective_from DATE NOT NULL effective_to DATE CHECK(effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from) FK fee_type_id → fee_type.id

billing_period  id UUID PRIMARY KEY code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE start_date DATE NOT NULL end_date DATE NOT NULL due_date DATE NOT NULL snapshot_date DATE NOT NULL status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','ISSUED','CLOSED'))

invoice  id UUID PRIMARY KEY occupancy_id UUID NOT NULL period_id UUID NOT NULL invoice_no VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE issued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','ISSUED','PARTIALLY_PAID','PAID','CANCELLED')) version BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE(occupancy_id, period_id) FK occupancy_id → household_apartment.id FK period_id → billing_period.id

invoice_line  id UUID PRIMARY KEY invoice_id UUID NOT NULL fee_type_id UUID NOT NULL rate_id UUID vehicle_id UUID utility_bill_id UUID UNIQUE description TEXT NOT NULL quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity >= 0) unit_price NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0) amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0) FK invoice_id → invoice.id FK fee_type_id → fee_type.id FK rate_id → fee_rate.id FK vehicle_id → vehicle.id FK utility_bill_id → utility_bill.id

contribution_campaign  id UUID PRIMARY KEY name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL start_date DATE NOT NULL end_date DATE NOT NULL suggested_amount NUMERIC(18,2) CHECK (suggested_amount >= 0) purpose TEXT NOT NULL

contribution  id UUID PRIMARY KEY campaign_id UUID NOT NULL household_id UUID NOT NULL pledged_amount NUMERIC(18,2) CHECK (pledged_amount >= 0) created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL UNIQUE(campaign_id, household_id) FK campaign_id → contribution_campaign.id FK household_id → household.id

payment  id UUID PRIMARY KEY household_id UUID NOT NULL intent_id UUID UNIQUE recorded_by UUID payment_no VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE channel VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('CASH','BANK_TRANSFER','QR','EWALLET')) amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0) paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('POSTED','VOIDED')) external_ref VARCHAR(120) idempotency_key VARCHAR(80) UNIQUE UNIQUE(external_ref) FK household_id → household.id FK intent_id → payment_intent.id FK recorded_by → app_user.id

payment_allocation  id UUID PRIMARY KEY payment_id UUID NOT NULL invoice_line_id UUID contribution_id UUID amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0) CHECK((invoice_line_id IS NULL) <> (contribution_id IS NULL)) CHECK(amount > 0) FK payment_id → payment.id FK invoice_line_id → invoice_line.id FK contribution_id → contribution.id
receipt  id UUID PRIMARY KEY payment_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE receipt_no VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE issued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL snapshot TEXT NOT NULL FK payment_id → payment.id

payment_intent  id UUID PRIMARY KEY household_id UUID NOT NULL created_by UUID NOT NULL provider_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL merchant_order_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE idempotency_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE expected_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (expected_amount >= 0) currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL CHECK (currency IN ('VND')) status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','EXPIRED','CANCELLED')) expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL version BIGINT NOT NULL payment_id UUID qr_content TEXT checkout_url TEXT FK household_id → household.id FK payment_id → payment.id

payment_intent_item  id UUID PRIMARY KEY intent_id UUID NOT NULL invoice_line_id UUID contribution_id UUID amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0) FK intent_id → payment_intent.id FK invoice_line_id → invoice_line.id FK contribution_id → contribution.id

provider  id UUID PRIMARY KEY code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL service_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (service_type IN ('ELECTRICITY','WATER','INTERNET','OTHER')) contact TEXT

service_subscription  id UUID PRIMARY KEY occupancy_id UUID NOT NULL provider_id UUID NOT NULL customer_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL valid_from DATE NOT NULL valid_to DATE FK occupancy_id → household_apartment.id FK provider_id → provider.id

utility_bill  id UUID PRIMARY KEY subscription_id UUID NOT NULL period_id UUID NOT NULL provider_bill_no VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0) imported_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL source_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL FK subscription_id → service_subscription.id FK period_id → billing_period.id

reconciliation  id UUID PRIMARY KEY provider_id UUID NOT NULL period_id UUID NOT NULL created_by UUID NOT NULL created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRMED')) FK provider_id → provider.id FK period_id → billing_period.id

reconciliation_item  id UUID PRIMARY KEY reconciliation_id UUID NOT NULL utility_bill_id UUID NOT NULL billed_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (billed_amount >= 0) collected_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (collected_amount >= 0) remitted_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (remitted_amount >= 0) note TEXT FK reconciliation_id → reconciliation.id FK utility_bill_id → utility_bill.id
